## Discord Rich Presence - Show what you're listening to on your Discord profile while scrap and the Discord desktop app are open. Your status reads **Listening to** *artist*, with the track, artist, album, cover and a live time bar. - Turn it on in **Preferences → Discord**, or right-click the menu bar icon and choose **Discord Rich Presence**. - Customize each line with `{title}`, `{artist}`, `{album}` and `{service}` (for example "by {artist}" or "on {album}"), or pick a preset. Choose whether "Listening to …" shows the artist line, the track line or the app name. - Covers come from last.fm, and animated covers are frozen to a still frame. You can also use your music app's artwork, including custom covers. Apple Music artwork is uploaded to a temporary public image host for this, and falls back to last.fm when it can't be uploaded. - Add up to two buttons: **Play on Apple Music**, **Play on Spotify**, song.link, or the last.fm track, artist or album page. Buttons are only visible to other people, not on your own profile. - Hide your activity while paused, or keep it without the time bar. - Use the same settings everywhere or separate settings for Apple Music, Spotify and [untitled], or hide your activity for a service entirely. - A live preview shows how your activity will look as you change settings.
## Reports - Added **monthly and yearly reports** alongside weekly ones. Monthly reports come out on the first Friday after the month ends, and yearly reports on the first Friday of the new year. - Open any past week, month or year from a calendar, or step through them with the arrows. - New **Listening clock** showing the hours you listen most, in your time zone. - New **Top tags**, based on the tags of your top artists. - Monthly and yearly reports show the **day you scrobbled the most**, with that day's top artist, track and album. - Yearly reports show your scrobbles **month by month** and the **month you scrobbled the most**, with its top artist, track and album. - Your last 4 weekly reports are saved on your Mac, so they open instantly. - Long reports load faster and show their progress.
## Notifications - Get notified when your monthly and yearly reports are ready. The **Weekly report** toggle is now **Reports** in **Preferences → General → Notifications** and covers all three.
## Menu bar - The menu bar icon is filled while you're scrobbling, and outlined when nothing is playing, scrobbling is paused or last.fm can't be reached. - Added **Settings…** to the right-click menu.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/swagdotsh/scrap/compare/v1.7...v1.8

## Reports - Added a **Reports** page with your weekly report (Saturday to Friday): scrobbles compared with the previous week, your top artist, album and track, and the new artists, albums and tracks you discovered.
## Notifications - Get notified every 5,000 scrobbles, when you discover a new artist, and when your weekly report is ready every Friday at 16:00 Central European Time. Clicking a notification opens the matching page. - Turn each one on or off in **Preferences → General → Notifications**.
## Profile - Choose the period for your top artists, albums and tracks: last 7 days, 30 days, 365 days or all time. - **See more** opens a window with your top 50 for that chart and period.
## Now Playing - Added animated album covers, with an option to prioritize fetching them.
## Scrobbles - Shows what you're playing on another device, according to last.fm, and refreshes every 30 seconds while open.
## Friends - Fixed friends always showing no recent listening. Each friend now shows their latest scrobble and whether they're listening right now.
## Settings - Added **Remove “(feat.)” and “(with)” from song titles**. - Added **Include (Apple Music Edition)** to the album suffix cleanup.
## Other - The session key is no longer sent in request URLs. - scrap remembers the page you were on.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/swagdotsh/scrap/compare/v1.6...v1.7

## Now Playing - Added a heart beside the track name showing whether it is loved on last.fm. Click it to love or unlove the track without changing Apple Music favorites.
## Settings - Added **Love favorited songs (Apple Music)** to automatically love the current song on last.fm when it is favorited in Apple Music, including favorites added during playback.
## Menu bar - The scrap popup now closes when you click outside it, including clicks in other scrap windows.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/swagdotsh/scrap/compare/v1.5...v1.6
